title: Quest text read 'You're in Thornwold. Find Keeper Rowan, in the Understory, and carry Wren's question to her' while the player character was standing in The Keepers' Hall, Hollowbrook — the opposite hold from the one named.
where: The Keepers' Hall (Hollowbrook) — 'Two Keepers, One Covenant' quest, after asking Keeper Wren if any keepers remain elsewhere
